native_mechanisms: Silence-swats fix the marks' given order on the flat stone before any heap is folded — position is addressed, never re-spoken

Each heap races the musk deer's mountain stride (uphill twist, downhill fold, doubling back on itself) with the running shape carried forward into the next heap, so no heap keeps the shape it entered with
Search the result in squares like the drifting man: turn the shape ninety degrees and fold its corners into its own centre, repeatedly, until one changed mark smears across every square
The owl calls the final shape inside the dreamer inside — sealed to one fixed small size, with every intermediate heap burned so the token cannot be walked back to its marks
core_technique: Wide 1024-bit ARX state (16 x 64-bit lanes, pi-digit IVs) absorbing 128-byte blocks by XOR plus a multiply-free Speck128-style rotate-add-xor round with the state chained across blocks (AVX2/OpenMP-parallelised), then BLAKE2b-style column+diagonal G rounds and a one-way 1024->64-bit fold finished by murmur3 fmix64.
